# BREW Tools Suite

**Author:** QUALCOMM Incorporated<br/>
**Platforms:** BREW

BREW developer tool suite:

- BREW AppLoader — application loading and working with the phone's EFS;
- BREW AppSigner — signing applications to run on the phone;
- BREW Logger — viewing and analyzing the debug log;
- The Grinder — automated application stress testing.

The distribution includes user guides and an automation interface via
Perl.
